answers.p1: Lowercase kebab-case (e.g. csv-export), because names appear in config files and URLs.
answers.p2: It raises PluginNotFound (a KeyError subclass) and never returns None.
answers.p4: Settings arrive through configure(settings) called after the factory creates the plugin (factories take no arguments); the registry does not call configure.
answers.p6: Directory discovery, reload command, and docs were listed as not started (in that order).
answers.p7: Directory discovery, then the reload command, then docs.
